# Set Occurrence

![Set Occurrence function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/occurrences/set.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Signals the supplied occurrence and makes its pending waiters eligible to resume. No application data is transferred and no acknowledgement is awaited. This is an effect even without an output terminal. An invalid reference cannot signal another resource and is diagnosed.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

<details>
<summary>Retained binding and help description</summary>

This is the source declaration, not the current measured product-execution assessment.

Signals the supplied occurrence and makes all pending waiters eligible to resume without waiting for their acknowledgements. No payload or queued message is created. This is an effect even though it has no output; it must not be eliminated or globally serialized with unrelated branches.

</details>
